concept: Projective Mechanism Connection: keep one invariant nonlinear mechanism h(J), factor each context-specific realization as theta=(a,b,s) in f(J)=a+bJ+s*h(J), and learn a low-complexity connection describing dtheta/dlogRPM from theta and an independently observable operating-context scalar.

parent_reinterpretation.note: The nonlinear mechanism direction learned in corrected coordinate and plain J was effectively identical. The large raw curve-collapse advantage of the coordinate warp shrank to about 4.5% after affine output rebinding, indicating much of the apparent context drift lived in realization/write coefficients rather than mechanism identity.

connection.prediction: Bind theta from exactly three input-selected probes on one calibration RPM run. For target RPM rt, theta_t=theta_cal+ln(rt/r_cal)*([1,theta_cal,c0]@B). No target-RPM probes are used.

development_data.source: 139 consumed UIUC V1/V2 development families from v0.14
development_data.status: development only; all measurements were already consumed before v0.18

twenty_family_disjoint_partition_stabili.interpretation: The context-conditioned realization connection consistently outperformed the scalar coordinate warp across 20 deterministic family-disjoint partitions.

negative_controls_and_discarded_hypothes.local_c75_reynolds_proxy: rejected in development: adding c/R at 75% radius to the crude D^2 scale worsened best-exponent relation on 83 geometry-matched families (correlation magnitude fell from about 0.57 to 0.38 and residual error increased)
negative_controls_and_discarded_hypothes.nonlinear_coordinate_field: v0.17 frozen failure preserved; corrected geometry audit did not rescue it
negative_controls_and_discarded_hypothes.higher_order_connection: second- and third-order polynomial-in-delta-logRPM transitions were worse than the first-order affine connection in development

claim_boundary: This is development evidence only. A clean external confirmation must use a separately collected dataset and must freeze the mechanism, B matrix, probe rule, parsers, controls, metrics, and gates before reading target performance outcomes.
